en: Ah! I've heard of you. I lead the Elite Four. My name is Lance, and I'm a dragon trainer.
Dragons are mighty Pokémon, hard to catch and harder still to raise. Their strength is beyond question.
There's no running away now. Prepare to lose!
I can't believe it. My dragons have been beaten...
You're the one who beat the Elite Four. But there's still the Champion to face. You know who that is, don't you?
The Champion waits through that door. Go. I'd like to know how it ends.
